what: Every press of a stamp chip plays a 600ms bounce on the stamp and then keeps the expanded code faded (opacity 0.15) for 250ms before a 700ms fade-in, so the answer the reader asked for is only fully readable about 0.95s after each tap. Readers press these chips many times in a row (four chips in P33).
evidence: rs-ch27.css:105-108: '@keyframes ch27-press { 0% { translateY(-14px) } 45% { translateY(6px) } 100% { none } }', '.motion .press-stage.run .press-art { animation: ch27-press 0.6s ease-out }', '.motion .press-stage.run .press-out pre { animation: ch27-ink 0.7s ease-out 0.25s both }' with 'ch27-ink from { opacity: 0.15 }'. Motion audit (Animations on): 'ch27-press 600ms', 'ch27-ink 700ms d250' on every chip click. Restarted with a reflow hack (rs-ch27.js:211), so rapid taps restart from zero. Under reduced motion / Animations off nothing plays (correct).
fix: `ch27-ink 0.7s ease-out 0.25s` on the output → delete it (remedy 1: the code is the answer, show it at once); `ch27-press 0.6s ease-out` with a 6px overshoot → `ch27-press var(--dur-ui) var(--ease-out)` from `translateY(-8px)` to none, no overshoot (why: frequently triggered UI stays under 300ms; keyframes on a rapidly re-triggered element restart from zero).

what: The timeline's 'now' hand animates the layout property left over 350ms with the built-in ease, on every step, including arrow-key steps.
